resources.string: Multitouch, grid, colours, brightness, refresh rate
DisplayManager has no default display: the composer is not running.
xdpi/ydpi give a %1$s inch diagonal: the panel physical size in the device tree or the composer is wrong.
No vsync arrived: the screen is off or the app is in background. Run with the screen on.
Vsync does not match the declared refresh rate: wrong panel timing, the composer drops frames, or a power HAL caps frames. Expect stutter.
No input device reports the touchscreen source: the touch driver did not probe (firmware, regulator, I2C address) or its IDC file is missing.
Axis range %1$d × %2$d does not match the panel: Android scales it, but check for touches landing off the finger.
No readable backlight node in /sys/class/backlight or /sys/class/leds: brightness cannot be verified from sysfs (OLED panels or SELinux).
Only one finger was seen. If you used more, the driver reports single touch (type A protocol or wrong IDC).
Closed before every cell was reached; if some cells never lit up, that area of the touch panel does not respond.
Multitouch draws one trail per finger with coordinates; the grid finds dead zones.
Does every touch land under your finger, with no ghost touches?
Full-screen colours and gradients. Tap to go to the next one. Look for dead pixels, tint, banding and uneven backlight.
Colours uniform, no dead pixels, smooth gradients?
Move the slider to both ends: the test passes when the backlight node follows. The setting goes back to normal when you leave.
Does the screen go from very dim to very bright without flicker?
Pick a display mode to check that the panel switches.
The fps counter only redraws this screen; scrolling elsewhere may still stutter.
Do scrolling and animations look smooth?
